cros-disks: simplify MountManager::GetMountEntries() As MountManager::GetMountEntries() always returns a newly constructed vector of MountEntry struct, this CL simplifies the code by having MountManager::GetMountEntries() return the vector directly instead of via an out argument. cros-disks: remove |Disk::is_mounted_| and Disk::set_is_mounted() Disk::is_mounted() should simply be based on whether |Disk::mount_paths_| is empty or not. This CL removes |Disk::is_mounted_| and Disk::set_is_mounted() to avoid any potential out-of-sync issue between |Disk::is_mounted_| and |Disk::mount_paths_|. As Disk::is_mounted() is no longer a trivial getter of a member variable of Disk, it's renamed to Disk::IsMounted(). BUG=chromium:767645 TEST=Run unit tests. TEST=Run platform_CrosDisks{DBus,Filesystem} tests.
